title: The Hydrosphere
seo_title: Grade 10 Physical Sciences: The Hydrosphere Worksheets (CAPS)
standard_text: The hydrosphere: its composition and interaction with the other global spheres; the water cycle; water as a solvent; water quality and pollution; conserving water in South Africa. (summary of CAPS Physical Sciences, Grade 10, Chemistry: The hydrosphere)
meta_desc: Free Grade 10 Physical Sciences worksheets (CAPS): water on Earth, the water cycle, ions in water, water quality and water conservation. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: The hydrosphere is all the water on Earth.
key_sub: Water dissolves many substances, so it is easily polluted.
body_html:
How to think about it

The hydrosphere includes oceans, rivers, dams, groundwater, ice and water vapour. Water moves through the water cycle by evaporation, condensation, precipitation and run-off, and links the atmosphere, lithosphere and biosphere.

Water is a good solvent, so it carries dissolved ions such as calcium, chloride and nitrate. Water quality is tested by pH, conductivity and dissolved oxygen. South Africa is a water-scarce country, so water must be saved and protected from pollution.

Example

Which process in the water cycle forms clouds?

Water vapour cools.

Answer: condensation

Example

Why does sea water conduct electricity?

Think of what is dissolved in it.

Answer: it contains dissolved ions

Common mistakes

  • Thinking most of Earth's water is fresh water.
  • Thinking clear water is always clean.
  • Thinking groundwater is not part of the hydrosphere.

faq.q: Why is South Africa called water-scarce?
faq.a: It has low and uneven rainfall and high evaporation, so there is little water per person.

faq.q: How can water be saved at home?
faq.a: Fix leaking taps, take short showers and reuse grey water in the garden.
